corrections.claimed_speedup: Mixed and mostly slower; Fontations is not faster than HarfBuzz OT overall. Issue #2196 (body revised 2026-10-04, HarfBuzz 692a0aa30e vs Fontations 08bfef45) geometric means of Fontations/OT time (above 1 means Fontations is slower): nominal glyphs 1.52x, horizontal advances 1.39x, vertical advances 1.10x, vertical origins 1.62x, glyph extents 1.33x, drawing 1.56x, paint 1.16x, load face and shape 1.06x (derived from page data). Fontations is faster in 10 of 96 rows, mainly varied Roboto Flex vertical origins and glyph extents and Adobe CFF2 glyph extents. Worst row: Adobe VF Prototype nominal glyphs 3.50x slower. The earlier revision (eff2d6b9 / ec902bd2) had geomeans 1.53x, 1.39x, 1.11x, 1.58x, 1.29x, 1.51x, 1.26x and 1.05x with Noto Serif Myanmar nominal glyphs 3.12x as the worst row. No FreeType library timing is on the page.
corrections.compiler_and_flags: Clang 21.1.7 for HarfBuzz, meson --buildtype=release -Db_lto=true -Dfontations=enabled -Dbenchmark=enabled; Rust 1.94.0-nightly (2025-12-20), release profile, fat LTO, one codegen unit; HarfBuzz commit 692a0aa30e, Fontations commit 08bfef45 (revised 2026-10-04; the earlier revision measured eff2d6b995e0b45e3224079640457fa524c411b9 and ec902bd22b5b045e0178bcc3010604e36a7b8342); run as taskset -c 6 b/perf/benchmark-font --benchmark_filter="/(fontations|ot)$" --benchmark_min_time=0.05s --benchmark_repetitions=7. Harness skews against Fontations: the Rust std is built with optimize_for_size and forced frame pointers, and there is no cross-language LTO.

tier_reason: Tier unchanged (C), not-faster flag stands. Enricher e110 (2026-10-05) updated the record: HarfBuzz main pins kb v2.07 (ca6c962) while the header is now v2.28e; variable-font support was added in v2.28 and the SourceSerifVariable infinite loop was fixed (issue #44 closed), so the maintainer's 'no variable-font support' note is outdated; the kb version measured in July 2025 is unknown and the 2.06/2.07 changelog performance work was never re-measured.

corrections.caveats: Disputed speed claim, kept as a flagged not-faster entry. A WebSearch snippet attributed to the author (X post and developer blog, unreachable here) says kb is on average 4.5x faster than HarfBuzz at shaping on HarfBuzz's test suite extended with the author's tests, Ryzen 9 5900HX, clang 20, Linux; no per-test numbers or harness were found on any reachable page, and the kb README and header carry no benchmarks. The only opened comparison is by HarfBuzz maintainer Behdad Esfahbod (an interested party) on 2025-07-23 in harfbuzz discussion #5375, using HarfBuzz's public Google Benchmark harness (perf/benchmark-shape.cc) and the kbts backend (src/hb-kbts.cc, enabled by meson option kbts; HarfBuzz 11.4.0 NEWS says it is 'purely for testing and performance evaluation'). That run found kb slower on every font (2x to 160x) and 40x to 760x slower at font loading; CPU, compiler, flags and kb version were not stated, and timings go through HarfBuzz's buffer API wrapper, whose hb-kbts.cc allocates glyph storage per call (a small tax that cannot explain the gaps). kb's font load builds glyph x lookup bit matrices, which matches the 40-760x slower load. A third-party user (kb issue #21, 2025-07-13, libraqm harness) also measured kb about 2x slower than raqm/HarfBuzz. HarfBuzz main pins kb v2.07 (ca6c962) in subprojects/kbts.wrap while the header is now v2.28e (2026-10-02); the 2.06/2.07 changelog lists performance work that was never re-measured. Variable fonts were added in v2.28 and the SourceSerifVariable-Roman infinite loop (issue #44) and crash issues #43, #61 and #63 are fixed; there is no fuzzing. kb provides no cluster information (display-only shaper).
